content: Our analysis in terms of sentiment and Dialogue Acts supports the presence of the three selected therapeutic factors – Universality, Altruism and Instillation of Hope – in OSG more than in Twitter. The main contributors to this conclusion are the facts that there is more positive change in the sentiment of the original posters in OSG (people seeking support) and that in OSG even negative and neutral comments are likely to lead to positive changes.
